results.title: r/PetPeeves on Reddit: Tons of people commenting 'fake' and 'AI' on everything.
results.snippet: Lately anything with a yellow tint is "AI generated" to them, so I took a piss yellow photo at a concert the other day to post and mock. Thank you for not lumping me in with the complainers. After I hit send I was like "oh no, they are going to think I am one of them" which I am not. And yea I keep thinking about CGI and the "real" actors who refused to use it... and then I think about CGI today... ... That is because we can't tell the difference.
